correctness.rationale: For every a,b>0 and 0<r<1 the calculation exactly separates same, opposite, and adjacent side pairs, integrates the opposite-side diamond and adjacent-side hyperbolic complement, and proves a unique universal root of N(t) by monotonicity of N derivatives. The side probabilities include genuine arclength weights; affine normalization is applied conditionally, not to the side weights. Boundaries and the atom at scale one are explicit. The independent clipping checker passed 1,650,000 Monte Carlo chord comparisons across five r values and three aspect ratios. The infinite claim rests on exact integration and calculus, not the finite diagnostic.

value.rationale: The central homothetic target is a canonical probe of chord penetration. The complete distribution (including its nontrivial atom at scale one) is an exact benchmark for perimeter-uniform sampling, a model different from Crofton lines. The universal \(r_\star\) where every rectangle has the same hit probability and the strict reversal of the unique optimum across this threshold give a structural shape-optimization theorem; the logarithmic correction identifies the adjacent-side geometric mechanism. No arbitrary finite slice or unsupported downstream conjecture is needed.
